batch117
Snapshot: Candidate 26cf950d982dcd6c4a3cad7a95c6de8c43992641; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 9eefaf5e9665bf33d9c6c7d62f98243d07ce2971. Opening and closing gates both passed; four new stroke files raw-identical.
Scope: Read every requested guidance/rubric window; all 4 primary EN/RU lessons; 11 EN/RU context pairs; 4 linked-only pairs; 4 English comparison bodies; all 17 whole KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence and header; 50 JMdict entries; all 4 KanjiPedia texts; all 411 typed rows; 12 proposals, 4 adjudications, 4 clarifications, 4 outside-limit records and 3 exact navigation diffs. All returned completely, exit 0. No windows failed; no web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, strokes (息10, 恥10, 想13, 悲12), 心/61 key, selected compounds and examples agree with frozen source and official records. Attributed KanjiPedia component/origin accounts and modern mnemonics are correctly distinguished. No confirmed Japanese-fact defect.
C2 CLEAN: New lesson links resolve to existing pages; absent Russian word articles remain plain text. All three navigation changes are only standalone glyph wrappers with correct relative targets. Independently checked each directed quiz pair against current titles and sourced senses below; no target sense matches the foil title. No reverse/transitive inference.
C3 CLEAN: Four lessons and navigation contexts are comprehensible Russian; Japanese forms remain clear. No confirmed correctable language defect.
N001息→自 S-intro + S-negative: 息’s top 自 is an explicit shape comparison; breath/rest/son senses do not mean self (typed 自: «сам; себя»).
N002息→思 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 心 and contrasting 自/田 are accurately taught; 息’s sourced senses do not mean «думать; чувствовать».
N003息→怒 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 心, different upper forms are accurately distinguished; breath/rest/son does not match «гнев; сердиться».
N004恥→聞 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 耳 is explicit and contrasted with 心; shame does not match «слышать; спрашивать».
N005恥→耳 S-intro + S-negative: Ear is accurately labelled as the sound element, not 恥’s meaning; shame does not match «ухо».
N006恥→息 S-intro + S-negative: Lesson accurately marks only partial shared outlines; shame does not match «дыхание».
N007想→親 S-intro + S-negative: Partial 木/目-like outline comparison is qualified; thought/conception does not match «родитель; близкий».
N008想→集 S-intro + S-negative: 木-at-base/top-side visual comparison is accurate; thought/conception does not match «собирать; собираться».
N009想→息 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 心 and different 自/相 tops are explicit; thought/conception does not match «дыхание».
N010悲→想 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 心 and distinct 非/相 tops are explicit; grief/compassion does not match «мысль; замысел».
N011悲→息 S-intro + S-negative: Shared 心 and different 非/自 tops are explicit; sadness/grief does not match «дыхание».
N012悲→怒 S-intro + S-negative: Distinct 非/女+又 tops are explicit; grief/compassion and anger are related emotions but not interchangeable answers («печаль» vs «гнев; сердиться»).
L001 息 SUPPORTED: readings/facts, rest compounds, whole-word 息子 reading and distinction of literary そく sense are sound; omission of that rare reading is not misleading.
L002 恥 SUPPORTED: shame/embarrassment, ずかしい spelling, 恥じる/恥じらう and source-supported sound-component account are accurate.
L003 想 SUPPORTED: readings, word meanings/する, ソ [高], おもう [外], and mnemonic/source distinction are supported.
L004 悲 SUPPORTED: readings, い-adjective vs godan verb, 悲劇 and compassion/喜 senses are accurately bounded.
A001 SOURCE-SUPPORTED: 息をする/吸う/吐く, 息子 むすこ as whole word, and 休息する are supported; no frequency claim.
A002 SOURCE-SUPPORTED: 恥ずかしい’s bounded awkwardness gloss, 恥/はじ, okurigana, 恥じる and 恥じらう are supported.
A003 SOURCE-SUPPORTED: 予想/想像 with する, 感想, and qualified 思/想 learning advice are supported.
A004 SOURCE-SUPPORTED: 悲しい adjective, 悲しむ godan verb, and 悲劇 are supported.
NAV01 words/恥ずかしい.md: NAV-ONLY; wrapper links to ../kanji/恥.md; visible prose/metadata unchanged.
NAV02 words/息子.md: NAV-ONLY; wrapper links to ../kanji/息.md; pre-existing 子 link and whole-word むすこ explanation preserved.
NAV03 words/悲しい.md: NAV-ONLY; wrapper links to ../kanji/悲.md; visible prose/metadata unchanged.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; rest/breathing/son neighbours flagged, none a direct distractor. O002 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; 取/チ contacts flagged, no direct pair. O003 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; thought/ソウ neighbours flagged, no direct pair. O004 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; emotion/ヒ contacts flagged, no direct pair.
Findings: none
Optional: No correction warranted for omitting 息 そく «сын»: JMdict marks it formal/literary, while the lesson correctly explains 息子 as むすこ and preserves ソク metadata.
Limits: No app/runtime quiz execution, learner testing or native-speaker study; safety dispositions concern the actual typed titles, assigned lessons and read dictionary senses. No tests/builds/validators run. No public dictionary web pages fetched; official evidence was the complete bound helper text.
